map.等比求和公式的两个版本？: What are the two versions of the geometric sum formula?
map.有限项 S=a1(1-r^n)/(1-r)；无限项且 |r|<1 时 S=a1/: For finitely many terms S=a1(1−r^n)/(1−r); for infinitely many terms with |r|<1, S=a1/(1−r). An infinite series with |r|≥1 diverges and has no finite sum.
map.r=1 时分母为 0，公式失效；此时每项相等，和直接为 n×a1。: When r=1 the denominator is 0 and the formula fails; every term is then equal, so the sum is simply n×a1.
